name: Sanremo (Italy)
description: Blue field with a white canton bearing a red Greek cross throughout.
history: Municipal flag of Sanremo, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 17 December 1928.

features.role: white canton with a red cross throughout
